body:
Criticizes the other witches and later steps forward against the adventurers herself.

Recorded role and choices

In September 2025, Sorrel complains from the shadows about both the party and the witches’ progress. In November, another named appearance brings her openly into the confrontation, furious at the company’s interference. Her words suggest a demanding attitude toward the other witches, but they do not by themselves establish rule over every coven.
